contacts.name: Baba Sule
contacts.bio: Thirty years on the Oshoja–Eko Crest route. Knows every pothole by name. Calls Lucky 'my pikin' and means it.

contacts.name: Amaka Nwosu
contacts.bio: Runs a stall in Balo Market. Can unlock any phone and outtalk any customer. Lucky's oldest friend.

contacts.name: Kemi Lawson-Bright
contacts.bio: If there is an owambe on Eko Crest, Kemi planned it, crashed it or is suing it.

contacts.name: Shina Garage
contacts.bio: Controls the Oshoja park 'levies'. Smiles a lot. Never with his eyes.

missions.title: First Day on the Danfo
missions.summary: Baba Sule needs a conductor. Hang off the side of his yellow danfo, shout the route, collect the fares — and don't let anybody 'forget' their change.

objectives.text: Meet Baba Sule at Oshoja motor park
Reach the Eko Crest bus stop

missions.title: Go-Slow Getaway
missions.summary: A pickpocket on an okada snatched a passenger's bag in the go-slow. Weave through the traffic and get it back.

objectives.text: Return the bag to Madam Comfort

missions.title: Balo Market Run
missions.summary: Amaka's shipment of phone screens is stuck across Balo Market. Thread an okada through alleys, wheelbarrows and Task Force raids before closing time.

objectives.text: Deliver to Amaka's stall before closing
Bonus: don't crack a single screen

missions.title: Owambe Crasher
missions.summary: Kemi needs proof a rival promoter is passing off fake aso-ebi as designer. Get into the VIP canopy, take the photos and leave before the MC calls your name.

objectives.text: Charm your way past the gate aunty
Slip into the VIP canopy unnoticed
Leave before the bouncers find you

missions.title: Area Toll
missions.summary: Shina Garage wants you to collect his 'levies' from danfo drivers — including Baba Sule. Collect, or walk away and make an enemy.

missions.title: Stilt Town Waters
missions.summary: Shina's boys are blocking medicine canoes into Stilt Town. Take a speedboat, escort the canoe, and lose the Lagoon Wardens in the stilt maze.

objectives.text: Take the speedboat at the jetty

missions.title: Third Lagoon Bridge
missions.summary: The rival promoter is fleeing to the airport with Kemi's sound system money. Midnight. Ten kilometres of bridge. No go-slow to hide in.

objectives.text: Run the rival off the bridge road

missions.title: Shina's Garage
missions.summary: Shina seized Baba Sule's danfo and its papers. Sneak into the garage at night, take them back, and hold the gate while Baba drives out.

objectives.text: Hold the gate for Baba Sule

missions.title: Night Bus East
missions.summary: Lagos is too hot. Baba Sule has a cousin in Port Harcourt who needs a driver. Get to the luxury bus park before Shina's boys find you.

objectives.text: Get Baba Sule to the bus park

missions.title: Suya Rush Hour
missions.summary: Kemi's VIP guests want suya from a specific mainland spot. Hot. Now.

objectives.text: Deliver it hot to Eko Crest

hustles.name: Danfo Conductor
hustles.description: Shout the route, pack passengers, collect fares, give change (or 'no change'). Comfort and speed raise your cut.

hustles.name: Okada Dispatch
hustles.description: Deliver food and parcels through traffic on an okada. Don't drop the jollof.

businesses.name: Mainland Shine Car Wash
businesses.description: Buckets, foam and gist. Every danfo in Oshoja passes through.

businesses.name: Island Suya Spot
businesses.description: Late-night suya on Eko Crest. Big boys queue here after the club.

businesses.name: Lucky Line Danfos
businesses.description: Your own fleet of yellow buses. Baba Sule is head driver.
